summary: Domain-agnostic reference resolution engine. resolve_references_in_dict() walks a dict recursively replacing 'secret:...' prefixed strings using a caller-supplied resolver. resolve_references_in_model_tree() does the same for a pydantic BaseModel's field tree, handling SecretStr unwrapping and nested model rebuilding. Skips SETTINGS_SOURCE_* and SETTINGS_CLASS bookkeeping fields.
extension_points: prefix parameter — defaults to 'secret:' but supports any prefix string
lifecycle_notes: resolve_references_in_model_tree mutates the model instance in-place via setattr
Nested BaseModel fields are rebuilt as new instances (type(value)(**resolved_dict)) to satisfy pydantic frozen=True constraints
risks: Mutates model in-place — not safe to call concurrently on the same instance

evidence.detail: Imported and called in __init__ when secrets_provider is set
